title: parseAncestries missing 5 subraces on real SRD 5.1 PDF
description:
With loreweaver-w8h's creature-coverage fix landing, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack now passes the creature check but hits an ancestry coverage failure:

> SRD 5.1 ancestry coverage check failed: parsed 13 ancestry record(s), expected 18. Missing expected ancestry record(s): Mountain Dwarf, Wood Elf, Dark Elf (Drow), Stout Halfling, Forest Gnome.

Found subraces: Hill Dwarf, High Elf, Lightfoot Halfling, Rock Gnome (only the FIRST subrace of each parent race parses; the others are silently dropped). All 9 base races parse correctly.

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack on a tree that has the loreweaver-w8h creature fix applied (or any state where creature coverage passes).

Investigation pointers:
- This failure is pre-existing — it's not caused by w8h. It was masked by the creature coverage check failing first.
- The pattern (only the first subrace per parent parses) suggests parseAncestries.ts may not advance past the first subrace heading per race block, or column-aware extraction interleaves subrace headings with body prose in a way the parser doesn't tolerate.
- KNOWN_SUBRACES in parseAncestries.ts maps source headings to record names; the regex / heading match logic is in the same file.

See packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseAncestries.ts.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #135: trimmed EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_ANCESTRY_NAMES from the PHB 18-name list to the SRD 5.1's actual 13-name set (9 races + Hill Dwarf, High Elf, Lightfoot Halfling, Rock Gnome only). Added real-PDF regression test pinning the parser output against the vendored SRD. Next pipeline failure (feature:cleric:destroy-undead duplicate) tracked as loreweaver-8gp.
